title: Facet load share at lumbar (variable) - Farooq et al. 2005 (as cited in the review) (secondary, Ghezelbash 2020 review)

quantity.name: facet load share
quantity.definition: % of compressive force transmitted via the neural arc, mean +/- SD (stress profilometry)

source.authors: Ghezelbash F, Schmidt H, Shirazi-Adl A, El-Rich M
source.sample: not stated in review (see primary: Farooq et al. 2005 (as cited in the review)); human cadaveric lumbar specimens of Farooq et al. 2005 (as cited in the review), as compiled in Ghezelbash et al. 2020 Table 2

protocol.summary: Stress profilometry; load share of neural arc (not facet force in N).
how_to_simulate: Compute % of compression transmitted through the neural arc
protocol.notes: Secondary data compiled in a review (Ghezelbash et al.'s review). Sample size, specimen age, rate and cycles are not given in the review; use the primary paper for these. Primary source: Farooq et al. 2005 (as cited in the review).

data.note: value printed identical to the compression row in the review; verify in primary

extraction.from: Table 2 (summary of in vitro facet force measurements)
extraction.check_notes: Re-read against the rendered Table 2 image (page 5, 200 dpi): every value, +/-, min/max, units and level labels match the pdftotext output.

pass_rule.rule: |model-mean| <= 1 SD (mean+/-SD) or min <= model <= max (ranges); widen for facet-force method bias (Wilson 2006)
